description: This file defines the ADODB2_ibase class, which extends the ADODB_DataDict class, providing database abstraction layer functionalities specific to Interbase. It includes methods for type mapping and placeholder functions for SQL alterations not supported by Interbase.

classes.name: ADODB2_ibase
classes.description: Class for handling Interbase database specific data dictionary operations, extending the generic ADODB_DataDict class.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps custom meta types to actual SQL data types for Interbase.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Placeholder for generating SQL to alter a column; not supported in Interbase.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Placeholder for generating SQL to drop a column; not supported in Interbase.
